summary: DXP Enterprises filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement (ABL credit facility) on July 2, 2026. The facility provides up to $225 million in asset-based revolving loans, with $210 million for U.S. borrowers and $15 million for Canadian borrowers, maturing in 2031. The filing is a routine refinancing of existing debt, not a special situation. Terms include SOFR/CORRA-based pricing with margins from 1.25%-1.75% and facility fees. The obligations are secured by substantially all assets. This is a standard credit agreement amendment, no strategic event.
